breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained contradictory boundary conditions: Dirichlet on the entire boundary and periodic on the spatial boundaries. The ground truth correctly removed the periodic condition. The agent's generated specification also correctly removed the contradictory periodic condition, stating only 'Apply Dirichlet boundary conditions: u = 0 on the entire boundary ∂((0,1) x (0,1))', which aligns perfectly with the ground truth.
